gloss: to overtake, to pass, to surpass

definitions.explanation: To catch up with and move ahead of someone or something that was in front.
To go beyond someone in ability, achievement, or quantity.

examples.japanese: {前|まえ}の{車|くるま}を{追|お}い{越|こ}した。
examples.english: I passed the car in front.

examples.japanese: {弟子|でし}が{師匠|ししょう}を{追|お}い{越|こ}した。

notes:
{追|お}い{越|こ}す is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to overtake or surpass.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {追|お}う (to chase) + {越|こ}す (to cross) → to chase and pass over

ASPECT (ている):
{追|お}い{越|こ}している indicates an ongoing action of passing or a state of having surpassed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {車|くるま}を{追|お}い{越|こ}す (pass a car)
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{禁止|きんし} (no passing)
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{車線|しゃせん} (passing lane)
- ～を{追|お}い{越|こ}して{一位|いちい}になる (pass ~ and take first place)

TRAFFIC TERMS:
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し: overtaking, passing (noun)
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{車線|しゃせん}: passing lane
- {追|お}い{越|こ}し{禁止|きんし}: no passing zone

[Register: Neutral]
